The resulting mixture was then stirred at 70 °C and the progression of the reaction was monitored by TLC. At the end, the mixture was cooled to room temperature, filtered, and the solvent was removed under reduced pressure. After that, under a nitrogen atmosphere, the oxidized MBH adduct was dissolved in 10 cm3 THF, borane in dimethyl sulfide (2 mol/dm3 in THF, 1.0 equivalent) was added to the mixture, and the resulting solution was stirred. The reaction was monitored by TLC. After reaction completion, 2 cm3 methanol was added, the inert atmosphere was removed, and the solvent evaporated under reduced pressure.
